outcomeNote: suggestion is rejected in the next unit (sukkah.sugya187)

segments.he: וּמְנוּקָּבִים כְּמִין שְׁנֵי חוֹטָמִין וְכוּ׳. לֵימָא מַתְנִיתִין רַבִּי יְהוּדָה הִיא וְלָא רַבָּנַן, דִּתְנַן: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: בַּלּוֹג הָיָה מְנַסֵּךְ כׇּל שְׁמוֹנָה. דְּאִי רַבָּנַן, — כִּי הֲדָדֵי נִינְהוּ!
segments.en: § The mishna continues: «And» the two basins were «perforated» at the bottom with «two thin,» perforated, «nose-like» protrusions, one broad and one thin. The Gemara asks: «Let us say» that «the mishna is» in accordance with the opinion of «Rabbi Yehuda and not» with that of «the Rabbis, as we learned» in the mishna that «Rabbi Yehuda says: One would pour» the water «with» a vessel that had a capacity of «one log» on «all eight» days of the Festival, unlike the wine libation, for which a three-log basin was used. According to his opinion, there is a difference between the capacity of the wine vessel and that of the water vessel; therefore, it is clear why the opening in the wine vessel was broader. «As, if» the mishna is in accordance with the opinion of «the Rabbis, they are the same» as the capacity of the water basin, three log. Why, then, were there different sized openings?
